concerns.text: T011 (Control Corpus) depends on T009 (Generation) for the 'merged_dataset.csv' output, but T011 is marked [P] (parallel-safe). T011 cannot run until T009 completes and writes the file. This violates the 'producer before consumer' rule. T011 must be sequential to T009 or T009 must be split into 'schema definition' (parallel) and 'data generation' (sequential).

T024 (Orchestration) depends on T011 (Merged Dataset) and T018 (Stats). T024 is marked [P]. It cannot run in parallel with T011 or T018 as it consumes their outputs. This is a hard ordering violation.
T021 (Human Rater) depends on T023 (Sampling) and T020 (Rubric). T021 is marked [P]. It cannot run until T023 produces the sampling list. This violates the 'producer before consumer' rule.
T022 (Cohen's κ) depends on T021 (Ratings). T022 is marked [P]. It cannot run until T021 produces the ratings file. This violates the 'producer before consumer' rule.

Tasks T034-T038 (Review Enhancements) depend on US1 and US2 logic (Generation and Analysis). They are marked [P] but cannot run until the base pipeline (T009-T019) is functional. Marking them [P] implies they can run in parallel with the base pipeline, which is false.

T008 (Prompt Engineering) is marked [P] and placed in Phase 2. However, T009 (Generation) depends on the prompts loaded by T008. While T008 is a setup task, the [P] tag is misleading if it implies it can run in parallel with T009. It must complete before T009 starts. Consider removing [P] or clarifying it is parallel only with other Phase 2 tasks, not Phase 3.
